reply: Yes, the Bahia Rare Earths Project is located in Brazil. According to the document (NASDAQ_ATLX_2020.pdf, Brazil Minerals, Inc. Annual Report), the project is described as being "located in the SW portion of State of Bahia in the Northeast Region of Brazil" (see chunk d60da2d1). Additionally, a summary table lists "Rare Earths | Bahia | 24,162 acres" under the column "Location in Brazil" (see chunk ae43101c), confirming that the project is situated in the state of Bahia, Brazil.
